issues.description: Method return type mismatch for Stock.add(String): The UML in problem_statement.md declares Stock.add(String) as returning void (problem_statement.md line 50), but both the template implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java line 32) and the reference solution (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java line 32) implement it as returning int. This inconsistency between the written specification and the provided code can confuse students about the correct signature to implement and whether callers expect a return value.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification and the code consistent. Prefer updating problem_statement.md (the UML) to declare Stock.add(String): int to match the template and solution implementations. If instead you change the code to void, update all call sites and examples to not rely on a return value. Updating the UML to 'add(String): int' is the least disruptive fix and preserves existing code behavior.
